notes: Own site (springvalleychinachef.weebly.com) has a scanned in-store menu image, but its prices ($6-8 entrees) are roughly half of current DoorDash/UberEats prices for the same dishes (e.g. Cashew Chicken $7.35 on the scan vs $19.20 on both marketplaces) -- clearly a years-stale photo, discarded for pricing though its section/dish lineup matches current listings closely, confirming same menu structure. No first-party ordering platform found. Priced off DoorDash, cross-checked against UberEats -- both are delivery marketplaces (not independent owners for markup purposes per findings), so this is NOT a validated markup check; recorded low confidence. Reached: Desserts, Salt and Pepper, Appetizer, Fried Rice, Soup, Lo Mein, Chow Mein, Chow Fun (partial), Chicken, Beef. Not reached: Egg Foo Young, Spicy Mapo Tofu, Pork, Shrimp, Pan Fried Noodles, Vegetables, Family Meal, Combo Plates, Extras, Drinks -- this is a partial capture, not the full menu.
